notes.title: Free Weekend - Moto Racer 4
notes.content:
Play Moto Racer 4 for FREE starting now through Sunday at 1 PM pacific time. 
You can also pickup Moto Racer 4 at 90% off the regular price!

Offer ends Tuesday at 10 AM Pacific Time. 


Enjoy the splitscreen mode or the multiplayer online mode with your friends for free this weekend!

notes.title: 2nd TRACK DLC AVAILABLE: ANTIQUE ANTICS
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Today we release a new track DLC for Moto Racer 4.

Explore forgotten temples in the desert with the 2nd track pack for Moto Racer 4: Antique Antics

Demonstrate your skill as you hurtle through impressive ancient ruins half-buried in the desert sands, on the two new circuits included in this pack:

Asphalt – Trident Temple: Challenge your opponents on this track with tight and fast bends, and choose the line you'll take through this sacred site.

Dirt – Bumpy Ride : Ride the crest of the dunes on this new track through th?e vast expanse of the desert. Will you be able to stay in the saddle

Already available for Season Pass owners.

notes.title: NEW DLC AVAILABLE : SLICED PEAK TRACKS
notes.content:
NEW DLC AVAILABLE : SLICED PEAK TRACKS

Reach for the sky with the 1st DLC for Moto Racer 4: Sliced Peak
Travel along snow-covered, winding mountain roads and show your skill at handling extreme conditions on the two new circuits included in this pack:

Asphalt - Drifting Away: Skim across the slippery mountain roads, being careful not to plunge over the precipices ahead to a fiery demise.

Dirt - Ice Edge: Ride through this mystical track built around a Dragon cut out of the heart of the mountain.

Already available for Season Pass owners

****
More DLC ready to hit the road (and the ground) this summer, stay tuned!

notes.title: New Patch 1.5 - 01/31/17
notes.content:
Hi there

Patch 1.5 is now available (01/31/17) . It's mainly focus on the Carreer mode with some other fixes!

Stickers:
5 new stickers can be unlocked by the player in both Career and Quickplay modes.
- Once the player wins all the Nemesis challenges.
- Once the player earns the style medal for each challenge.
- Once the player completes Chapter 10.
- Once the player wins all the Gold-level challenges.
- Once the player beats all the developers' best times.

Career:
The AI difficulty has been adjusted for all chapters.
New text information has been added to improve the bet system.
"Overperformance" has been added: if the player wins a challenge with a better performance than they had wagered, they gain additional style points at the end of the challenge.
The results screen can now be skipped.
A notification has been added for when the player has points left to spend in the paddock.

Championships:
The "Try again" button is now available in the Pause menu. This allows the player to restart the current race, but not restart the whole championship.
When a player and an AI end up with the same amount of total points after the last championship, the player will now be considered as the winner.

Tracks:
Track shortcuts are now highlighted.
Bug fix for collisions and respawn zones.
The smoke FX is now properly displayed.

Loading screens:
11 new tips have been added.

Gameplay:
When a player performs a super wheeling, a reminder to hold the button is displayed.
AI can no longer nudge players.

Audio:
The audio mix between engine and background noise, and music has been adjusted.
The reverberation in first-person view has been fixed.
The collision sound between two motorbikes has been adjusted.
New sound added when players perform wheelings.
New sound added for swerves.

Various bug fixes

notes.title: Moto Racer 4 HotFix 11/14/16
notes.content:
Here is the log of the HotFix deployed yesterday:

Audio:
•	Improved audio mix

Career:
•	New texts added.
•	The difficulty of the first three chapters has been adjusted (for 2 & 3-star objectives).

Game modes:
•	Time Attack & Hot Lap
•	Bug fix: new records are now displayed in the track selection screen.
•	A medal is now awarded to players who manage to beat the developers' record.

Menu:
•	Online score display correction."

Split screen:
•	Option of adding up to three AI rivals in split-screen mode.

In-game:
•	Cockpit view visual improved.

Other:
•	Various bug fixes.
